the powertrain energy ﬂow has

shown that
the optimization-based control strategy reduces
losses in the hydraulic system by reducing the pump speed
in electric mode and uses the ICE more efﬁciently in areas
with lower BSFC. The test results with the demonstrator con-
ﬁrmed that the required time for the optimization calculation

the proposed
strategy is capable of real-time operation. The test results with
